info.title: API.SH: Publix
info.description: The Publix API from API.SH: public Publix data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A store's current savings: weekly ad deals, digital coupons and extra savings, with search by text or category. Each saving: id, type, title, brand, department, savings, additional savings, deal info, description, fine print, final price, minimum purchase, categories, image, start and end dates. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/publix-savings

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to search the savings for.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Publix products by keywords or browse a category, for one store, with the shop's filters (values in `facets`) and eight sorts. Each product: id, item code, name, brand, size, link, images, price and price text where the shop shows them (publix.com prices only items on promotion; `price_source` says where a price is from, `price_note` explains), original price, savings, sale and price-reduction flags, promotion, coupon flag, aisle location, categories, description and alerts, plus `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. With `online=true` (needs `q`) the response adds `online`: the same store's Publix online ordering results for the keywords with a price for every item (online prices, which Publix states are higher than in-store), size, unit price, deal, availability and stock level, the online store's number, name and address, the shopping method and `fetched_at`; it pages with the same `page` and `limit`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/publix-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords. Optional when category is set.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id from /publix/v1/categories, or a category link.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filters as name::value pairs from a search's `facets` (the `filter` value), comma-separated, e.g. onSale::true.

parameters.name: online
parameters.description: true: also return this store's online ordering prices for the keywords in `online` (needs q).

parameters.name: online_method
parameters.description: Shopping method for the online prices (default delivery; pickup prices have matched delivery so far).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
